text:
alex: Heads-up — NewRiver reported a spike of 503s from their Dedicated pool3 instance, customer P1. Logs point at KV cache miss spikes around 21:05 UTC. Can someone own triage and a short-term workaround? @maya

maya: On it, looking at logs now. Do we know if there was a deploy right before 21:05?

sahil: quick look — two GPUs in pool3 threw OOMs then downstream 503s. Seems related to batching + quantized model path. Adding @jenna for runtime kernel/memory side.

jenna: If it's OOM, we can reduce batch_target and flip to a more conservative kernel path. Proposal: batch_target 8 -> 4 on pool3 and enable fallback cpu-quant path. ETA ~30m for hot-config and canary.

alex: Is that a config-only change or do we need a code PR? Customer wants timeline to share. @luis any constraints on pushing a canary?

luis: Config-only. I can approve and roll canary once there's a PR. @sahil can you open the PR with the change to pool3 config?

sahil: Opening PR now — https://git/repo/pull/1234 (placeholder).

incidents-bot: PR 1234 created by sahil — "reduce batch_target for pool3 to mitigate OOM 503s"

maya: Triage note: temp mitigation looks safe from initial tests. Long-term root cause looks like bursty KV cache growth + insufficient eviction. I'll file a follow-up issue for autoscheduler + eviction tuning.

jenna: Also recommend adding route fallback to smaller model variant if the large model queue is saturated. Need a short acceptance test to verify fallback path.

alex: OK owners: short-term config change = sahil/luis, runtime kernel follow-up = jenna, monitoring/docs/customer comms = maya. Timeline I told support: PR -> canary in ~20m, monitor 15m, then roll to full in next ~30m if healthy.

maya: I've messaged the customer with ETA ~1h and asked for any traces they can share. Will attach logs when available.

luis: :thumbsup: ping me if canary shows >10% error rate and I'll pause rollout.

jenna: quick diagnostic I ran: ```curl -sS http://pool3/metrics | grep kv_cache_miss``` shows the spike at 21:05. Suggest kv_eviction_policy=aggressive as a safe short-term opt.

sahil: PR merged, canary started (canary-id: c-202303). Initial canary logs show no new OOMs on canary nodes.

alex: Nice — monitor for 10m then proceed. After full rollout we need a short postmortem and schedule work for autoscheduler + cache eviction. @maya can you open the postmortem template?

incidents-bot: Canary healthcheck passed after 18m. Rolling to 50%.

maya: Filed follow-up issue https://issues/RI-789 — summary: "NewRiver pool3 P1: short-term mitigation applied; follow-ups: autoscheduler memory limit, kv eviction tuning, model-fallback route." Added owners and sprint priority.

luis: Rolled to 100% at +50m. Customer reports nominal behavior now.

alex: Great. Closing loop: next steps — jenna to draft runtime checklist, maya to update runbook, sahil to add the config change to infra changelog. I'll coordinate customer update.

maya: Will update support thread and close the customer loop after a final sanity check.

jenna: I'll start a small ticket for kernel memory accounting and add acceptance test for route fallback.

alex: Thanks everyone.
